newsitem.title: USA: Albank completes $50 mln private placement.
newsitem.headline: Albank completes $50 mln private placement.

text.p: Albank Financial Corp said Monday its Albank Capital Trust I unit has completed a private placement sale of $50 million of 9.27 percent capital securities due June 6, 2027.

The company said the proceeds were used to purchase 9.27 junior subordinated deferrable interest debentures due June 6, 2027 issued by Albank Financial, which intends to use the proceeds for general corporate purposes.
